actions.action: Water the pilea lightly 1-2 days before separating
Loosen soil with a chopstick or skewer, lift the pilea by its root ball and tease out tangled roots
Put the plant in a nursery pot with drainage set inside the decorative planter
Alternatively, lift the plant out of the decorative pot to water it
Repot the pilea in fresh potting mix with perlite at the same depth
Place the pilea in bright, indirect light away from harsh sun for two weeks
Check the pilea soil and water when the top inch is dry
Water the kalanchoe only after the soil dries out fully
Keep the syngonium soil evenly moist in bright, indirect light

reason: The thread's fix was rearranging the plants so the kalanchoe gets the most light, but the answer calls everything healthy, focuses on separating the pilea and never addresses the light imbalance; its reassurance is mild and its advice isn't damaging.
